title: Generalize VcsHistory/ProtocolList Surfaces to GraphTimeline/BlockList
description: Rename the app-named SurfaceKind variants VcsHistory -> GraphTimeline (wire "vcs-history" -> "graph-timeline") and ProtocolList -> BlockList (wire "protocol-list" -> "block-list") across ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx (+ host component file rename), framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, and fix all call sites across the repo (including owning app's plugin crate and any shared files touched minimally). Rename scene structs VcsHistoryScene/HistoryColumn and ProtocolListScene/ProtocolPaletteEntry->BlockPaletteEntry accordingly. Part of the SurfaceKind framework-purity generalization series (sequential stage, shared files may already have prior renames from earlier stages). Parent ticket not yet materialized at ticket_open time (see GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES).
summary:
Investigated and found this exact task already fully completed and closed by a prior session under a sibling ticket path (26/07/17/GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES/GENERALIZE-VCS-HISTORY-PROTOCOL-LIST-SURFACES-TO-GRAPH-TIMELINE-BLOCK-LIST, status closed) before I opened this duplicate ticket — I had not checked for an existing covering ticket first and should have called ticket_reopen on that one instead; noting this process error.

Verified via exhaustive repo-wide grep (excluding target/, node_modules/, .repo/ backups, and .claude/worktrees/ stale copies) that the rename is complete and consistent everywhere in the live tree: SurfaceKind::VcsHistory->GraphTimeline (serde "vcs-history"->"graph-timeline"), SurfaceKind::ProtocolList->BlockList (serde "protocol-list"->"block-list"), VcsHistoryScene->GraphTimelineScene, ProtocolListScene->BlockListScene, ProtocolPaletteEntry->BlockPaletteEntry, UiComponentSceneNode fields vcs_history/protocol_list->graph_timeline/block_list (TS: vcsHistory/protocolList->graphTimeline/blockList), render_vcs_history->render_graph_timeline (+ //#region GraphTimeline / GraphTimelineTests), the react host components renamed to graph-timeline-host.tsx/block-list-host.tsx (GraphTimelineHost/BlockListHost) with the ui-interpreter.tsx registry re-keyed to "graph-timeline"/"block-list", and index.test.ts updated to the new names. Confirmed the two previously-broken struct-literal call sites (mathematical/plugin/rs/lib.rs empty_component_scene(), infinite/world/rs/lib.rs scene_with_selection()) already use graph_timeline/block_list fields. Confirmed vcs/plugin/rs/lib.rs and protocol/plugin/rs/lib.rs call sites (SurfaceKind::GraphTimeline, SurfaceKind::BlockList, GraphTimelineScene{...}, BlockPaletteEntry{...}) are consistent, and that vcs/plugin's own VCS_PLAY_WINDOW_HISTORY="vcs-history" window-id constant is an app-owned identifier (not the framework wire name) so correctly left untouched, as is the app-owned HistoryColumn name (generic, not app-specific) referenced by framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs (semio-framework-plugin). Found zero remaining stale identifiers anywhere in the live tree; no code changes were needed or made by me.

Verification run: `cargo check -p ui_wgpu` — PASSED (ran twice independently, both clean, ~16-21min each due to heavy shared build-directory lock contention from ~50-100 concurrent cargo processes from other active sessions in this workspace). `bun vitest run framework/core/js framework/renderer/react` — 30/30 tests passed; 1 suite (index.test.ts) failed to even transform due to an unrelated, currently in-progress sibling ticket (26/07/17/GENERALIZE-NOTE-CANVAS-SURFACE-TO-INK-CANVAS, status open) whose ui-interpreter.tsx import of "./components/ink-canvas-host.tsx" doesn't resolve yet because that file is still named note-canvas-host.tsx mid-rename — confirmed the graph-timeline/block-list-specific assertions in that same test file already reference the correct new names; this is pre-existing concurrent churn outside my ticket's scope, not something I touched. `cargo check -p semio-framework-plugin` — attempted three times (~1h4m, ~56min, and a third run) but could not reach completion within this session due to sustained, severe build-directory lock contention (peaked at ~100 concurrent cargo/rustc processes from other active sessions); each background process was eventually killed by the harness's task lifetime limit before producing output. Grep-confirmed this crate (framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs) only references the unrenamed, generic `HistoryColumn` type and never touches GraphTimelineScene/BlockListScene/BlockPaletteEntry/SurfaceKind::GraphTimeline/BlockList at all, so it has no code-level exposure to this rename; combined with the successful ui_wgpu check (which is where all the renamed types are actually defined), I have high confidence it would pass, but this specific command was not confirmed to completion — flagging for a follow-up check once the shared build queue clears.

No files were created, modified, or removed by me in this session — this was a verification-only pass confirming already-completed work (read/inspected only).
